source: Plan section 8, feature catalogue (docs/plan.pdf, 4 Nov 2026), F001 to F064
rule: shipped-local only when the code is reachable in the local app (App.tsx or a ?page= route in main.tsx) or run by a local pipeline command, and at least one tracked test exercises it; nothing is deployed, so nothing is shipped publicly

features.name: Live state map with freshness labels
features.notes: Judgement call: the map and its freshness labels run locally and their tests use committed S09 and Open-Meteo fixtures. No approved snapshot exists, so a fresh local run shows the empty state and the basemap only.

features.name: Radius filter and nearby list
features.notes: Point records use great-circle distance; area warnings stay in the list with a label (D58). Same snapshot caveat as F001.

features.name: Time slider and replay
features.blocker: No published snapshots exist to slide over (T045); the 2018 replay's S08 export is untracked and local only (H11 item 9, D166).
features.notes: Judgement call: only the 2018 replay with its reconstructed mode is built (D127); a slider over immutable published snapshots has nothing to read.

features.name: 3D terrain
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172): opt-in Map view select, Flat 2D stays the default; chooseView() fallbacks apply. No tile is stored.

features.name: Globe view
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172): Globe option of the Map view select; reduced motion sets camera durations to 0.

features.name: Wall mode
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172) at ?page=wall: connected means online and the last snapshot load did not fail; stale or disconnected walls show no alerts. With no approved snapshot it shows its empty state.

features.name: Feed health badges
features.notes: Missing health metadata reads unknown, never no hazard (D58). Same snapshot caveat as F001.

features.name: Event log and ticker
features.notes: The ticker is mounted in App.tsx; its strings are English literals (D154). Same snapshot caveat as F001.

features.name: Daily satellite image layer
features.notes: Judgement call: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172) with the terrain view, but no snapshot carries a dated S13 row, so the page says no imagery date was reported and shows none (no date is guessed).

features.name: Satellites overhead
features.blocker: sgp4 is in no lock, so predict() raises SourceUnavailable; S12 display terms wait for H11 (D109, D153).
features.notes: Adding sgp4 to requirements/geo.in is an agent follow-up that needs network access.

features.name: Transit stations and scheduled positions
features.blocker: S30 is licence restricted; no public transit snapshot until H11 (D115, D116).
features.notes: Kerala schedules are not verified.

features.name: Live buses
features.blocker: S38 blocked on owner step H04; live mode unavailable (D135, D138).

features.name: Historical train routes/stations
features.blocker: Not mounted with the transit layer (D116).
features.notes: S21 is a 2016 reference: clock text only, no position or ETA.

features.name: Flights and optional coastal ships
features.blocker: Not mounted (D153); ships need S26, blocked on H12.
features.notes: Aircraft (S10) is the only layer that qualifies; S11 is blocked on terms.

features.name: Fire hotspots
features.blocker: S25 needs a FIRMS MAP_KEY (H09).

features.name: Sachet alerts including provider-issued lightning
features.notes: Judgement call: local capture and display only; partial CAP coverage, no hosted feed. Lightning shows only when Sachet issues it; none is inferred from rain.

features.name: News-derived preliminary event pins
features.blocker: S41 has no publisher permission; 0 labelled texts; H13 review not done (D155, D156).

features.name: Flood-exposed roads
features.blocker: No road graph is built from S18 yet (S18 available, D174) and no flood labels or polygons (S43) (D128).
features.notes: S18 roads come from the owner's browser download (D174).

features.name: Public RERA projects
features.blocker: Reproduction needs written K-RERA permission.
features.notes: Owner item: email K-RERA (not a numbered H-step).

features.name: Building outlines
features.blocker: Not mounted until a public snapshot carries it; no PMTiles archive built (D117, D151).

features.name: Mandi price ticker
features.blocker: S22 needs a browser render; S23 has no publisher statement of its price denominator.
features.notes: Unknown price units cannot be rendered as prices (D58).

features.name: District crime totals if source exists
features.blocker: Not mounted until a public snapshot carries it (D114, D117).
features.notes: Lists the published district totals per year; maps nothing.

features.name: Place Lens: now/risk/forecast/history/nearby/sources
features.notes: Judgement call: the Lens runs locally, but risk and forecast show no model output and Nearby states that facilities cannot be verified (S18 facilities not yet exported, D59, D174). Same snapshot caveat as F001.

features.name: Official/model/inferred provenance
features.notes: Same snapshot caveat as F001.

features.name: Nearest hospitals/shelters/police/fire stations
features.blocker: S18 facilities passed the source check (D174) but are not yet exported to the map snapshot; no verified shelter record (S43).
features.notes: Next agent step: export S18 facilities into the snapshot; shelters never show opening status.

features.name: Shareable place URL and printable PDF
features.notes: Judgement call: print and link parsing run locally; a shared link resolves only through an approval file, and none is published until T045 and H11 (D59).

features.name: Reservoir levels and inflow forecasts
features.blocker: M02 and M03 need S28 daily history; M07 needs datum for 8 dams and S34 bulk OCR (T118).
features.notes: S32 Kerala dam levels are held locally (kl.md 'measured'), but no levels layer is mounted.

features.name: Ward/taluk flood risk
features.blocker: No dated ward flood labels (S43) and no audited Kerala history (S35, H10).

features.name: Landslide susceptibility
features.blocker: S37 has no inventory with footprint; S42 needs a Copernicus account (D126).
features.notes: H15 is proposed, not in amendments A5.

features.name: Taluk drought outlook
features.blocker: No outlook layer exists: M05 is a hindcast (D39) at district level (no taluk polygons); S08-derived outputs may be published, never rainfall values (H11 item 3, D166).
features.notes: Judgement call: the model is measured and owner-approved (D43) and its scores show on the local accuracy page (F036); ka-v1.md calls F030 measured in that sense. Intervals stay hidden (D42, T262).

features.name: 24-72h AQI/pollutant forecasts
features.blocker: S24 resource page could not be read by any tool (D133); 0 station rows.
features.notes: Retry is a re-run of T146 with a browser that can read page content; no new key.

features.name: Bus ETA/delay and bunching
features.blocker: S38 blocked on H04; 0 vehicle positions (D140).

features.name: 16-day price-spike warning
features.blocker: Zero price rows: S22 and S23 blocked (D55).

features.name: Rain what-if simulator
features.blocker: M20 needs an approved base model for the target; recorded as a blocked branch (D145).

features.name: SHAP explanations and uncertainty bands
features.blocker: M05 intervals cover 72.8% against an 80% gate, so they stay hidden (D42, T262).
features.notes: Judgement call: the intervals are measured and fail their gate. No SHAP values exist for any model: shap is pinned in requirements/ml.in but no code calls it (see Findings).

features.name: Accuracy page and daily matured backtests
features.notes: Judgement call: the minimal MVP table runs at ?page=accuracy locally (T257, T259); its plan task T046, the MVP gate, has not passed. No daily matured backtest exists because no model serves live predictions. H11 item 1 approved publishing the table on 11 Nov 2026 (D166); nothing is deployed.

features.name: Anomaly feed
features.blocker: 0 of 100 flags adjudicated, so precision is not measured (D159, D160).
features.notes: Proposed owner step: adjudicate 100 M16 flags with independent evidence.

features.name: Population exposed to risk
features.blocker: No verified hazard polygon exists (S37, S43); the exposure code is tested on an H3 cell only (D128).

features.name: Experimental route avoiding flagged roads
features.blocker: No road graph is built from S18 yet (D174) and no official shelter record (S43); every result says not a safe route (D128).

features.name: Heatwave/heat exposure layer
features.blocker: No Delhi source enabled; S01 keeps no issue-time vintages; S18 has no Delhi extract (D141, D174).
features.notes: Not owner-gated: enable S01 and S02 for Delhi and collect forecast vintages.

features.name: Crop health / NDVI
features.blocker: S42 needs a Copernicus account (proposed H15); no crop mask (D130).

features.name: Rainfall trend since 1901
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172) at ?page=climate after H11 item 3 (derived outputs only). Indices only, never millimetres (S08 licence); trends cover 1981-2025.

features.name: CMIP6 outlook to 2050
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172) at ?page=climate. Labelled climate projection, not a forecast; S06 has no named scenario.

features.name: Monsoon progress tracker
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172) at ?page=climate. The tracked year is 2025, a past year; onset is labelled inferred.

features.name: Past-disaster replay
features.blocker: Not mounted; the 122 S08 records exist only in a local, untracked export (H11 item 9, D166); S35 blocked (D127, D129).

features.name: Cited RAG Ask by text
features.blocker: Evidence support below the 0.95 gate (0.86 on 8 Nov, 0.80 on 11 Nov); extractive only; Workers AI waits for H05 (D101, D147).
features.notes: The page runs at ?page=ask locally, labelled research-only; the owner counts it for the MVP gate as research-only (H11 item 2, D166).

features.name: Voice input and read-aloud
features.blocker: It is an input to Ask, which is research-only (D148).
features.notes: Judgement call: the voice controls run on the local Ask page; they inherit Ask's research-only status.

features.name: Kannada/Malayalam/Hindi/English
features.blocker: kn, ml and hi strings and questions are unreviewed machine drafts; only English is selectable (A7, D147, D148).
features.notes: Needs a native-speaker review (A7).

features.name: Place watches
features.notes: Mounted 11 Nov 2026 (D172) in the record panel; device-local IndexedDB only. It appears once a snapshot exists; only expiry stops a signal (records carry no cancelled flag).

features.name: Telegram bot delivery to public state channels
features.blocker: S39 needs the bot, channel and token (H08).

features.name: Background Web Push
features.blocker: Disabled by the no-personal-data policy; needs a written owner policy revision (D150).

features.name: Daily cited brief
features.blocker: No job or schedule runs the brief and no completion stamp exists (D149).
features.notes: Judgement call: the brief builder is tested on real Sachet fixtures but no command or workflow produces a brief.

features.name: City Memory: every published snapshot
features.blocker: T045 needs the H05 and H06 tokens; no snapshot is published.

features.name: Analysis dashboards
features.notes: Judgement call: D161 calls the dashboards built, not mounted, meaning no public snapshot; they are reachable locally at ?page=analysis.

features.name: Data-quality dashboard
features.notes: Reachable locally at ?page=quality; same D161 wording as F054.

features.name: Open downloads and public static API
features.blocker: No export button is mounted and there is no host (D162).
features.notes: Only open, available sources pass the licence rule; S08, S30 and S34 are refused.

features.name: Offline PWA
features.blocker: No service worker is registered until an approved snapshot and host exist (D162).

features.name: Embeddable read-only widgets
features.blocker: Embedding needs its own path with frame-ancestors headers on a host; no host and no partner origin (D162).
features.notes: Judgement call: the read-only summary renders locally at ?page=widget, but it cannot be embedded anywhere.

features.name: State comparison
features.notes: Judgement call: reachable locally at ?page=compare; it compares status counts and coverage only, and every metric pair reads unavailable (D161).

features.name: Gauge interpolation / gaps study
features.blocker: No daily gauge data with coordinates (S27; S29 annual only).

features.name: Rain-price effect study
features.blocker: Zero price rows (S22, S23) (D126, D127).

features.name: Cross-state transfer and drift
features.blocker: No shared labels across states (D145).

features.name: U-Net flood mapping and GRU challenger
features.blocker: M17 needs S42 (proposed H15) and labelled events; M19 needs the blocked M02 baseline and a free GPU (H10) (D144).

features.name: Downloadable evidence and correction ledger
features.blocker: No prediction ledger exists (no model serves live predictions) and there is no host for downloads (D163).
features.notes: Correction and re-score functions are tested on temporary stores.
